name: Electrolux® Luxury-Glide® 27" W x 15" H Denim Blue Laundry Pedestal
shortDescription: The Electrolux Laundry Pedestal with Storage Drawer helps you organize the entire laundry room. They are perfect for storing laundry supplies, extra towels, cleaning supplies and more. By including a Laundry Pedestal, your Electrolux washer or dryer can be elevated for convenient height.

features.text: Raises your washer or dryer 15 inches, reducing strain and making loading and unloading easier.
Built-in drawer holds up to 50 lbs. of laundry essentials - keeping detergents, dryer sheets, and more organized and within easy reach.
Drawer glides open and closed with ease—even when fully loaded—for a premium feel and effortless access.
16% of this pedestal’s total product weight is made from recycled plastics and steel - helping reduce environmental impact without compromising durability
This laundry pedestal is compatible with all Electrolux 27" front load washer and dryers.
